items.heading: None of These Require Insider
items.text: None of these require insider knowledge, they are checkable in a first conversation or on the platform's own pricing page, before you commit to anything. The same checklist works whether you're weighing a narrow counselling service, a broader best career guidance website, or any platform marketing itself as the best online career guidance available, the criteria don't change just because the marketing does.

items.heading: A Fair Comparison Has
items.text: A fair comparison has to name what to watch for, not just what to look for. These apply to any provider in this space, not one in particular.

items.heading: Not Every Provider Adds
items.text: Not every provider adds the same thing on top of a generic report. This is the difference the evaluation criteria above point to.

items.heading: The Single Biggest Quality Signal
items.text: The single biggest quality signal is who is on the other end of the session, a trained counsellor working through your actual profile, or a sales rep steering every conversation toward the same course or college.

items.heading: Skill and Income Direction Separates
items.text: Skill and income direction separates strong guidance from a list of colleges: look for a skill-first plan with proof of work, not only a degree route.

items.heading: If a Platform Will Not
items.text: If a platform will not tell you the price until after a call, that is a process designed to build pressure, not to help you decide.
